# Ai2Data Services

> Ai2Data Services designs and implements AI-powered ecosystems — AI agents, modern data platforms, business intelligence and enterprise systems — built as one unified stack, from strategy to production. Founded in 2020, Ai2Data has delivered 200+ projects across 8+ countries.

Ai2Data works across five practices and a four-tier "knowledge layer" reference architecture: governed data products, an ontology and knowledge graph, AI models with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents, and a semantic model with business context. Security and governance apply at every layer.

Key facts:
- Company: Ai2Data Services (also "Ai2Data"), founded 2020
- Scale: 200+ projects, 8+ countries, 30+ certifications, 12 technology platforms
- Industries: financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, retail and e-commerce, technology, energy and utilities
- Platforms: Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS, Salesforce, Oracle, Databricks, Snowflake, Zoho, SAP, Tableau, Power BI, ServiceNow
- Trusted brands: Lakshmi Precision Technologies Limited; Libra Technical Maintenance Services LLC; Ficus Energy Oilfield Contracting LLC
- Engagement model: deep-dive discovery → architecture and roadmap → build, test and ship → optimize and compound
- Offer: new clients get a free 60-minute AI strategy call, no commitment
- Contact: support@theai2data.com, +91 99948 17615 (a senior consultant replies within 24 hours)

## Practices

- [AI & Agentic Systems](https://www.theai2data.com/ai-services.html): custom LLMs, RAG, autonomous agent orchestration, enterprise GenAI, in-app copilots, AI guardrails and compliance
- [Data Engineering](https://www.theai2data.com/data-engineering.html): lakehouse and data-mesh architecture, ETL/ELT and real-time streaming pipelines, cloud data warehousing, data governance and quality
- [BI & Analytics](https://www.theai2data.com/bi-analytics.html): executive dashboards, KPI frameworks, self-service BI, predictive and prescriptive analytics, embedded analytics
- [Business Operations Software](https://www.theai2data.com/business-operations.html): CRM, ERP, marketing, customer service and finance platforms, and the integrations between them
- [Workflow & Automation](https://www.theai2data.com/workflow-automation.html): RPA, workflow orchestration, ITSM automation, API integration and iPaaS, intelligent document processing
